## Details

<a id="sfx_sample_start"></a>
### [`sfx_sample_start`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_2a0a.asm#L6) `$2A0A`

*routine*

Unused set-up routine of the sample player: nothing calls it. It stops the CIA1 timers, sets sfx_sample_ptr = $0804 and sfx_sample_end = $0a04, clears the SID registers and sets sfx_volume = 15. Then it starts timer A (latch 8, continuous) and timer B (latch $0101, one-shot, counts timer A), with the timer B IRQ on.

- **Reads:** [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR)
- **Writes:** [`CIAICR`](../../memory-map.md#CIAICR), [`CIACRA`](../../memory-map.md#CIACRA), [`CIACRB`](../../memory-map.md#CIACRB), [`sfx_sample_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#sfx_sample_ptr), [`sfx_sample_end`](../../memory-map.md#sfx_sample_end), [`CIATALO`](../../memory-map.md#CIATALO), [`$DC05`](../../../../src/graphics/shadow_sprites_facing1.asm#L105), [`sfx_done`](../../memory-map.md#sfx_done), [`figure_parts_unused`](../graphics/figure_sprites_d000.md#figure_parts_unused), [`sfx_volume`](../../memory-map.md#sfx_volume), [`CIATBLO`](../../memory-map.md#CIATBLO), [`CIATBHI`](../../memory-map.md#CIATBHI)
